title: Decreto Legislativo 7 ottobre 2026, n. 179 — Disposizioni di adeguamento della normativa nazionale al regolamento (UE) 2024/1689 in materia di intelligenza artificiale
container-title: Gazzetta Ufficiale della Repubblica Italiana, n. 234
note: Published in the Official Gazette on 2026-10-08, in force 2026-10-23. Article 41 'Protection of workers in decision-making processes assisted by artificial intelligence systems' and Article 42 'Artificial intelligence, health and safety in the workplace' are this article's direct basis.

title: Decreto Legislativo 11 aprile 2006, n. 198 — Codice delle pari opportunità tra uomo e donna
note: Article 27 prohibits discrimination in access to employment: paragraph 1 covers selection criteria and hiring conditions, paragraph 2 extends the ban to indirect discrimination through pre-selection mechanisms. Article 40 shifts the burden of proving no discrimination to the employer once facts inferred from recruitment statistics are presented.

title: Decreto Legislativo 9 aprile 2008, n. 81 — Testo unico sulla salute e sicurezza sul lavoro
note: The basis for the duty to prepare a risk assessment document (DVR). Legislative Decree 179/2026 Article 42 folds the impact of AI systems into this assessment.

title: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 — General Data Protection Regulation
note: Article 22(1) — the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing that produces legal effects or similarly significantly affects the person. A pre-existing safeguard that predates Legislative Decree 179/2026 Article 41.

title: AI: what changes from 23 October
note: Commentary on Article 41's scope of prohibition, the three elements of the right to explanation, the nullity of non-compliant dismissals, and Article 42's integration into the workplace risk assessment.

title: Legislative Decree 179/2026 in the Official Gazette: authorities, penalties, employment roles
note: Gazette number and effective date, summaries of Articles 41 and 42, the point that consent does not exempt compliance, and AgID/ACN authority and penalty ranges.

title: Recruitment, gender bias and automated pre-selection under Legislative Decree 179/2026
note: Translation of the pre-selection exemption's original text, the narrowed-candidate-pool argument, the Equal Opportunities Code Article 40 burden-of-proof shift, recommendations to measure gender distribution at each stage and secure vendor contract terms, and the EU AI Act's December 2, 2027 application date for high-risk employment obligations.

title: Italy introduces workplace rules on artificial intelligence
note: A summary written for global HR practitioners.

title: Italy's AI Workplace Safety Mandate Takes Effect Thursday: Scheduling Tools Covered
note: Article 42's function-based scope (scheduling, workflow, task allocation, production monitoring tools), the three required DVR entries, fines of 3,557-9,113 euros with up to six months' detention, and enforcement by the national labor inspectorate.
